glossary.definition: (A) "Beneficiary form" means a registration of a security that indicates the present owner of the security and the intention of the present owner regarding the person who will become the owner of the security upon the death of the present owner.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1709.01 to 1709.11 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1709.01 - Uniform transfer-on-death security registration act definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Devisee" means any person designated in a will to receive a disposition of real or personal property.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1709.01 to 1709.11 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1709.01 - Uniform transfer-on-death security registration act definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Heirs" means those persons, including the surviving spouse of a decedent, who are entitled under the statutes of intestate succession to the property of an intestate decedent, including, when applicable, section 2105.06 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1709.01 to 1709.11 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1709.01 - Uniform transfer-on-death security registration act definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Person" means an individual, a corporation, an organization, or other legal entity.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1709.01 to 1709.11 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1709.01 - Uniform transfer-on-death security registration act definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Personal representative" includes an executor, administrator, successor personal representative, special administrator, and persons who perform substantially the same function under the law governing their status.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1709.01 to 1709.11 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1709.01 - Uniform transfer-on-death security registration act definitions.

glossary.definition:
(F) "Property" means anything that may be the subject of ownership, including, but not limited to, real and personal property and any interest in real or personal property.

(G) "Register," including its derivatives, means to issue a certificate showing the ownership of a certificated security or, in the case of an uncertificated security, to initiate or transfer an account showing ownership of that security.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1709.01 to 1709.11 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1709.01 - Uniform transfer-on-death security registration act definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Registering entity" means a person who originates or transfers a security title by registration and includes, but is not limited to, a financial institution maintaining security accounts for customers, a securities dealer or broker maintaining security accounts for customers, and a transfer agent or other person acting for or as an issuer of securities.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1709.01 to 1709.11 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1709.01 - Uniform transfer-on-death security registration act definitions.

glossary.definition: (I) "Security" has the same meaning as in division (B) of section 1707.01 of the Revised Code and includes, but is not limited to, a certificated security, an uncertificated security, and a security account.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1709.01 to 1709.11 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1709.01 - Uniform transfer-on-death security registration act definitions.
